original_test_intent: Verify every Type 10 description string resolves from the correct per-entry string index, uniquely or policy-consistently identifies the paired onboard-device type/status entry, and remains stable after reboot.
original_method: Parse every Type 10 type/status and description-index pair from the structure length, preserve raw string index and exact string-table bytes/text, compare normalized and exact forms to the approved legacy device inventory, then repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the exact/normalized descriptions, duplicate/blank policy and reboot plan. No firmware rename or physical device inspection is required.
required_inputs: Expected description string per Type 10 entry
Expected paired type and enabled status for identity
String policy for case, whitespace, aliases, duplicates, blank or invalid indices
Board revision and Type 10 versus Type 41 coexistence policy
Raw-capable parser plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS collection; do not change firmware strings, device enablement, drivers or BIOS settings.
Preserve the raw string index and exact source text before normalization; a rendered description alone loses provenance.
Validate every length-derived Type 10 entry and keep description paired with its own type/status byte; do not globally sort strings before mapping.
Do not accept a nonzero invalid string index as blank, and do not infer device functionality from its label.
Stop on malformed string table, duplicate ambiguity, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Parse all Type 10 entries, resolve and preserve exact descriptions, apply approved normalization and compare paired type/status identities before/after reboot.
Do not rename metadata, claim device functionality or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve exact descriptions, aliases and duplicate/blank handling for the legacy inventory.
Approve reboot/recovery, resolve ambiguous labels and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `Description String` may not be the decoder's literal label, and `-A1` cannot retain all entries, raw indices or their preceding paired type/status values.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 10 data, derive every entry from formatted length and report raw description index, exact resolved text, normalized text and paired raw/decoded type/status.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 10 Description String scope, source script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Resolve every Type 10 description index from the original string table, retain exact and normalized values and bind each one to its packed type/status entry; keep optional Type 41/OS names as additive aliases only.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Platforms publishing SMBIOS Type 10 On Board Devices Information.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, board and parser/dmidecode versions plus Type 41 coexistence state.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 10 entry and string-index layout, approved legacy onboard-device inventory and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw string-index provenance, complete entry iteration and type/status binding instead of an unreliable standalone description grep.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Increases coverage by detecting invalid indices, swapped descriptions, duplicate ambiguity and normalization-only differences.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Per-entry expected descriptions and explicit normalization/duplicate policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A correct descriptive string neither proves the corresponding device is physically present nor that it functions.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve aliases or normalized naming changes, but must retain the exact raw string and bind the alias to the same Type 10 type/status entry; Type 41 names cannot silently replace the source field.
expected_evidence: Approved board revision, per-entry description/type/status map and exact/normalization policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 10 raw structure with formatted length, every description index and exact string-table value
Per-entry exact and normalized comparison with duplicate/invalid-index analysis
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot index/string mapping diff
Engineer verdict; optional Type 41/OS aliases separately labeled

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source clearly targets Type 10 description strings; decoder label variation affects extraction only.

blocked_analysis.analysis: All indices and strings are safely parseable; missing expected names are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Corrects the fragile label grep and adds string-index provenance plus paired entry identity.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains normalization and no-functionality-claim safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Keeps Type 10 source semantics and treats Type 41/OS naming only as additive correlation.

review_improvement: Prevents swapped or invalid description indices from passing merely because the expected words occur somewhere in the structure.
independent_technical_reasoning: Each Type 10 description is a string-index reference paired with a packed entry; resolving and comparing that relationship is fully deterministic in software.
